title: Northwind: expansion and reporting

sentences.speaker: Jules Park
sentences.text: Every month I rebuild the minutes-consumed report by hand from exported logs.

sentences.speaker: Maria Chen
sentences.text: We would happily spend more if finance could see usage per project.

sentences.speaker: Luis Ortega
sentences.text: A usage dashboard is something other accounts have asked for.

sentences.speaker: Jules Park
sentences.text: Per-project breakdown, CSV export, and a monthly email. That is all.

sentences.speaker: Maria Chen
sentences.text: If you ship it before our budget cycle in the new year, expansion is easy.

summary: Northwind will expand if 12Labs ships a usage analytics dashboard with per-project breakdown and CSV export before their new-year budget cycle.
action_items: Luis to document usage dashboard requirements
Luis to share dashboard timeline in Q4
